name: Ivoard Hask
appearance: Big, bald and soft-voiced, a long scar through one eyebrow.
backstory: A nobody from Tethyr who captained the Ash Company, Ivoard turned on the last Velun king in the Night of Cinders (1453) and ruled Ossmaar for 38 years under the Ember Law and the Sky Gallows. In the Quiet Year he stopped every execution. He died on 26 Eleint 1491 with the Heartcoal pried from his crown; his last words were "Break it".
secrets: He knew the coal was killing him and tried to starve it.
He knew Lorard was Pellot Rook's son.
dm_only: The Heartcoal killed him; Oselle's poison only hastened it.

relationships.name: Lorard Hask
relationships.how: acknowledged him as firstborn, knowing he wasn't his
